chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'The people are saying that the Quran was revealed upon seven letters (phrases).' He said: 'They are lying, enemies of Allah! But it was revealed upon one letter (phrase) from the Presence of the One.'

key_terms.مِنْ عِنْدِ الْوَاحِدِ: From the Presence of the One (God)

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam say about the Quran being revealed on seven ahruf?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) refutes the popular notion of 'seven ahruf' as distinct, separate letters, asserting instead that the Quran descended as a single, unified revelation from the One God. This view aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition that emphasizes the essential unity of the Quranic text, distinguishing between the singular divine essence of the revelation and the various modes of recitation (qira'at) that facilitate its recitation. The Imam’s declaration serves to counter those who might fragment the Quran’s coherence by overemphasizing multiplicity in its foundational structure.
